nodes.label: The Second City Pint (Birmingham pub review site)
nodes.norm_label: the second city pint (birmingham pub review site)
nodes.rationale: Birmingham pub reviews are spread across generic sites that ignore what locals care about (pint quality, cask ale, cobs, real prices); this site targets locals, visitors and real ale fans.

nodes.label: 500 'Spilt Pint' error page
nodes.rationale: Links to a hardcoded '/' rather than {% url %}, so it still renders if URL resolution is part of the failure.

nodes.label: base.html site layout
nodes.rationale: Fonts and Font Awesome are preloaded non-render-blocking for mobile Lighthouse speed; text-muted/text-success colours are overridden for WCAG AA contrast.

nodes.label: GPS sessionStorage restore on load
nodes.rationale: Reapplies saved coordinates from sessionStorage without triggering a browser geolocation permission prompt on first page load.
